name: _cta.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  home-mosaic/_cta.scss — the card CTA button: corner-bracket chrome that
//  expands to a full frame on hover/focus.
//  Imported by home-mosaic.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Always white — cards always have a dark background so contrast is
// guaranteed in both light and dark mode.
.home-mosaic-btn {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
  @extend %TTL_XS;
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  text-align: center;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-lg);
  color: var(--color-white-raw);
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: var(--space-sm);
    height: var(--space-sm);
    transition:
      width 0.25s ease,
      height 0.25s ease;
  }
  &::before {
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    border-top: var(--space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.65);
    border-left: var(--space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.65);
  }
  &::after {
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    border-bottom: var(--space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.65);
    border-right: var(--space-hairline) solid rgba($color-white, 0.65);
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus {
    opacity: 0.75;
    &::before,
    &::after {
      width: calc(100% - var(--space-2xs));
      height: calc(100% - var(--space-2xs));
    }
  }

  // WebGPU corner-bracket overlay — the rust/corner-brackets canvas
  // repaints both L brackets once mounted inside the CTA; the
  // pseudo-element brackets drop out while the canvas is live.
  &-canvas {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  &:has(> .home-mosaic-btn-canvas:not(.is-fallback))::before,
  &:has(> .home-mosaic-btn-canvas:not(.is-fallback))::after {
    content: none;
  }
}
